a.lede: The web host said hackers exploited a vulnerability to access customer emails and files during a "deliberate attack."
a.title: Hackers stole DreamHost customer files and inboxes during months-long attack

b.lede: Security researchers found hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet, allowing anyone access to the hacking tool.
b.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
